title: 20. How do I open an existing survey for editing, etc.?
intent: This article helps EUSurvey survey managers understand or perform the task: How do I open an existing survey for editing, etc..
short_answer: From the 'Surveys' page, click on the 'Open' icon of the survey you want and the 'Overview' page will open with several new tabs. From here you can go to the 'Editor', test your survey, or access the survey's 'Results', 'Translations', 'Properties' etc.
